title: Security Council LIVE: Can conflict resolution keep pace as AI and drones reshape war?
content: When the UN was founded in 1945, computers, the internet and satellites were the stuff of science fiction. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is already assisting in targeting, drones are reshaping warfare and disinformation is spreading in unprecedented ways, fuelling record levels of conflict. The Security Council on Tuesday is weighing these changes, with UN chief António Guterres telling ambassadors, “killer robots must have no place in our future.”

title: Colombia: Guterres urges renewed commitment to landmark peace deal
content: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has commended Colombia for progress achieved in the decade since a landmark accord known as the Final Peace Agreement ended more than 50 years of insurgency but stressed the need to fully implement its provisions.

title: Heavy fighting in Ituri traps DR Congo Ebola responders: WHO
content: Heavy fighting near a hospital in Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has disrupted the vital work of Ebola responders and forced emergency teams to take cover for more than 24 hours.

title: Libya: UN mission urges probe into Benghazi port attacks
content: The UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) has called for an independent investigation into attacks carried out at Benghazi port and off the coast of the eastern city on Sunday.

title: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild
content: For five years, Zahra cared for an elderly woman in Iran and earned enough to get by. Now back in Herat, western Afghanistan, the 28-year-old trained midwife is unemployed. She lives with her parents and siblings, apart from her six-year-old son, who lives with her ex-husband.

title: Peacekeeping: With 500 paternity and child support claims unresolved, UN scales up accountability
content: The UN is adding new accountability measures to better support children fathered by peacekeepers, the Under-Secretary-General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, Catherine Pollard, announced Thursday.

title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties in 2026 already far exceed previous years’ tolls
content: This year has seen dramatically higher civilian casualties in Ukraine than any other year since the full-scale invasion of the eastern European country by Russia in February 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine (HRMMU) said on Tuesday.

title: ‘Hunger should not be a concern’: WFP steps in for families in Kenya who fled Ethiopia violence
content: The World Food Programme (WFP) is assisting thousands of families who fled recent violence in Ethiopia for the Moyale area in neighbouring Kenya, the UN agency reported on Tuesday.

title: At his final ASEAN Summit, Guterres upholds cooperation and action on Myanmar
content: UN Secretary-General António Guterres underscored the need for stronger collaboration with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) and an end to the crisis in Myanmar, in remarks to regional leaders meeting in the Philippine capital Manila on Monday.

title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: Unrest fuelled by armed groups holds back response
content: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread amid repeated and ongoing deadly attacks on civilians and frontline health workers by armed groups that are obstructing efforts to stop transmission, UN responders said on Friday.

title: Security Council LIVE: South Sudan’s first elections loom amid rising violence
content: With South Sudan just six weeks away from its first national elections since independence, the Security Council meets in New York Tuesday amid deepening political uncertainty and worsening violence. Ambassadors are expected to press for an inclusive process and credible polls, while civilians bear the brunt of fighting, hunger and displacement.
